from pathlib import Path
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    candidates = {color for _, color in row_lines} & {color for _, color in col_lines}
    divider = max(candidates, key=lambda color: sum(c == color for _, c in row_lines) + sum(c == color for _, c in col_lines))
    row_cuts = [r for r, color in row_lines if color == divider]
    col_cuts = [c for c, color in col_lines if color == divider]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    tiles = []
    colors = {}
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        tile_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            tile_row.append(cells)
            for v in cells:
                colors[v] = colors.get(v, 0) + 1
        tiles.append(tile_row)
    background = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    return [[1 if sum(v != background for v in cells) == 2 else background for cells in row] for row in tiles]
'''
path.write_text(source)
exec(source,globals())

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_lines = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [(c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    candidates = {color for _, color in row_lines} & {color for _, color in col_lines}
    divider = max(candidates, key=lambda color: sum(c == color for _, c in row_lines) + sum(c == color for _, c in col_lines))
    row_cuts = [r for r, color in row_lines if color == divider]
    col_cuts = [c for c, color in col_lines if color == divider]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_cuts + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_cuts + [w]
    tiles = []
    colors = {}
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        tile_row = []
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            tile_row.append(cells)
            for v in cells:
                colors[v] = colors.get(v, 0) + 1
        tiles.append(tile_row)
    background = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    return [[1 if sum(v != background for v in cells) == 2 else background for cells in row] for row in tiles]
